## Personality

The Twin Sailors are a pair of jolly tars. They are experienced individuals who have seen everything in the world.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)_

## History

In a letter written by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), the Twin Sailors are mentioned as characters featured in an imaginative composition written by Anne's pupil, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md).

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_
